page.overview:
Who is Mariana?

Dennis (husband) Mateo (son) Kadasha (stepdaughter) Unnamed Son

Mariana is a Hispanic-American mother of a mixed family from Oakland, California. Mariana was portrayed by American actress Natalie Martinez in the short film Battle at Big Rock.

Mariana is from Oakland, California. A Hispanic American, Mariana was once in a relationship with an unknown (possibly also Hispanic) man with whom she had a son, Mateo. Under unknown circumstances, Mariana separated from Mateo's father and became a single mother. Sometime before 2017, Mariana would meet Dennis, an African-American man who was also from Oakland and the father of Kadasha. Mariana and Dennis would form a relationship and in 2017 marry and bring their families together as one. Sometime later in either 2018 or 2019, Mariana would give birth to Dennis' unnamed son, the younger half brother of Mateo and Kadasha.

Mariana and her family embarked on a camping trip to Big Rock National Park in Northern California. They would stay at a camp ground with other campers in trailers. Mariana had attended to setting up the table for her family while her husband grilled chicken outside. When everyone sat down to eat, Kadasha and Mateo began arguing with each other leading Mariana to gently reprimand her children. She reminded them that they were now a family and needed to look out for and protect one another.
